resources.string: Switch off a skill you don\'t want to train, like the handstand or the human flag. Its exercises stay in your classes, greyed out, and leave your skill progress. Tap a skill to keep its first steps and switch off only the harder ones.
Switch off a step and every harder one leaves your classes. Switch one back on and every easier one comes back too.
You\'ve switched off the %1$s skill, so this isn\'t part of your workouts or skill progress. Do you want to continue?
Every exercise in this class belongs to a skill you switched off, so it counts as passed and you move straight on. You can still do it.
